channel.title: Pier & Point · Prequel Park (Power Station sub-area)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Prequel Park (Power Station sub-area) (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (Power Station sub-area): This record's map notes cited no source; they now cite the Port Commission's November 2025 memo (about 2 acres, about 0.4 acre on Port land), the final Design for Development and the Chronicle. A 'Spring 2026 construction-pipeline' listing that could not be found online was dropped as a source, and the note saying construction is proceeding per that listing was replaced by the memo's Q3 2026 target with the statement that no source confirms a start. The record no longer calls the company the property owner or says the 2020 approval 'first covers' this sub-area, the Unit 3 description now says the Chronicle does not name it, and an earlier change entry was re-dated as a coverage entry and re-cited to the Port memo and the Chronicle.
item.description: This record's map notes cited no source; they now cite the Port Commission's November 2025 memo (about 2 acres, about 0.4 acre on Port land), the final Design for Development and the Chronicle. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission Item 10A memo, 2025-11-14 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-11/111825_10a_potrero_power_station_lease_amendment_0.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); San Francisco Chronicle, 2025-05-22 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/power-station-park-sf-20339020.php).

item.title: Correction · Prequel Park (Power Station sub-area): This record's map status was corrected from 'under construction' to 'planned'. The timeline had shown 'under construction' today but 'planned' a couple of years into the future. No dated source has ever confirmed that construction has started, and the map status had simply never been corrected to match; the sibling 'Prequel Park (Port sub-area)' record already said 'planned'.

item.title: Milestone · Prequel Park (Power Station sub-area): Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the overall entitlement for the site on which Prequel Park was later proposed (in 2025); neither cited source ties the approval to this sub-area; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date (Apr 21, 2020)
